zh.caption: 圖 1｜兩條平行觀察路徑
zh.description: 每張卡內的箭頭表示資訊取得路徑；兩卡互補，不代表先後、權限升級或完整覆蓋。

items.title: 非驗證式視角
items.body: 未登入的掃描器 → 公開服務回應 → 可見入口與外部線索。

items.title: 驗證式視角
items.body: 使用核准身分的掃描器 → 目標允許存取的資料 → 套件、修補或設定證據。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Two parallel observation paths
en.description: Arrows within each card describe an evidence path. The cards complement each other; they imply neither sequence, privilege escalation nor complete coverage.

items.title: Unauthenticated perspective
items.body: Scanner without a login → Public service responses → Visible entry points and remote clues.

items.title: Authenticated perspective
items.body: Scanner using an approved identity → Data the target permits it to access → Package, patch or configuration evidence.

zh.caption: 圖 2｜三項證據分別記錄
zh.description: 依診斷順序核對三項狀態；前一項成功不自動證明下一項成功，沒有自動通過或權限提升。

items.title: 1｜設定生效
items.body: 確認這次工作對這個目標啟用了正確憑證；存進工具不等於已使用。

items.title: 2｜認證成功
items.body: 確認目標與服務接受身分；一台成功不代表整批成功。

items.title: 3｜必要檢查完成
items.body: 確認權限與輸出足以取得指定證據，並記錄失敗或缺漏；登入成功不能替代這項證據。

en.caption: Figure 2 | Record three evidence states separately
en.description: Check these states in diagnostic order. Success in one does not establish success in the next; no automatic pass or privilege increase is implied.

items.title: 1 | Configuration applied
items.body: Confirm this job enabled the right credentials for this target. Saving them does not establish their use.

items.title: 2 | Authentication succeeded
items.body: Confirm the target and service accepted the identity. One successful host does not establish group-wide success.

items.title: 3 | Required checks completed
items.body: Confirm permissions and outputs produced the required evidence, recording failures or gaps. Authentication cannot substitute for this evidence.
